title: Faisal Town Phase 1 Islamabad – F-18 Map, Blocks & Plots
description: Explore Faisal Town Phase 1 in F-18 Islamabad with Block A, B, B-1 and C guidance, map, plot sizes, resale options, houses and buyer checks.
h1: Faisal Town Phase 1 Islamabad – F-18 Map, Blocks & Plots
intro:
Faisal Town Phase 1 is the established Faisal Town development in Sector F-18 Islamabad, with residential and commercial areas organized around Block A, Block B, Block B-1 and Block C.

This hub brings together the Phase 1 map, block guides, plot sizes, resale activity, houses and buyer checks. It should be kept separate from Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II, which uses sector and enclave terminology instead.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 1 overview

Faisal Town Phase 1 is the established Faisal Town project associated with Sector F-18 Islamabad and the Rawalpindi-Kohat / Fateh Jang Road side of the Islamabad-Rawalpindi region.

Current Phase 1 material describes the project as covering Blocks A, B, B-1 and C.

The older established resale market is concentrated mainly in Blocks A, B and C, while Block B-1 is a newer addition and should be checked separately for its current development, booking and regulatory status.

For buyers, the most useful comparison is not simply “which block is best.”

The exact property should be compared by:

- plot size
- street
- road width
- access
- possession
- development
- surrounding occupancy
- dues
- transfer status
- total payable amount

## Faisal Town Phase 1 location

Faisal Town Phase 1 is located in the F-18 area and is commonly described along Rawalpindi-Kohat Road / N-80 near the M-1 Motorway and Fateh Jang Interchange.

Current project-focused sources place the development adjacent to the M-1 and near Fateh Jang Interchange. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

For a property purchase, do not rely only on the project-level location.

Confirm the exact block, street and practical route to the property.

## Faisal Town Phase 1 master plan

The Phase 1 master plan is organized around four block references:

- Block A
- Block B
- Block B-1
- Block C

Current Phase 1 material describes Blocks A, B and C as established or developed areas, with B-1 as a newer addition. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

Use the Phase 1 map for project orientation, then move to the individual block guide when comparing a property.

Do not use the Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II master plan for a Phase 1 property.

## Block A

Block A is one of the established Phase 1 residential blocks.

Current Phase 1 material places it near Main Gate 1 on Rawalpindi-Kohat Road.

Common residential sizes include:

- 8 marla – approximately 30 x 60
- 10 marla – approximately 35 x 70
- 14 marla – approximately 40 x 80
- 1 kanal – approximately 50 x 90

Current portal listings show active Block A resale inventory. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

Use the dedicated Block A page for exact map, price and availability comparisons.

## Block B

Block B sits beside Block A and is commonly described as running parallel to the M-1 Motorway.

Residential sizes commonly include:

- 8 marla – approximately 30 x 60
- 10 marla – approximately 35 x 70
- 14 marla – approximately 40 x 80
- 1 kanal – approximately 50 x 90

Current resale inventory remains active, particularly in 8- and 10-marla categories. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}

The exact street, corner position, road width and dues can materially change the price.

## Block B-1

Block B-1 is a newer Phase 1 block and should be treated separately from the established A, B and C resale areas.

Current project-focused sources list residential categories including:

- 5 marla – approximately 25 x 50
- 8 marla – approximately 30 x 60
- 10 marla – approximately 35 x 70

Some current sources also describe booking as closed. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}

Because B-1 is newer and its current regulatory and development position may differ from the older blocks, buyers should verify the latest status directly before booking or purchasing resale inventory.

I would not publish a strong “approved / unapproved” claim on this page without checking the current regulator record at the time of purchase.

## Block C

Block C is positioned near Gate 2 and is connected with the wider Phase 1 road network.

It has the broadest common residential size range among the Phase 1 block pages covered on this website:

- 5 marla – approximately 25 x 50
- 8 marla – approximately 30 x 60
- 10 marla – approximately 35 x 70
- 14 marla – approximately 40 x 80
- 1 kanal – approximately 50 x 90

Current Phase 1 material also describes Block C as sharing boundaries with the other Phase 1 blocks. :contentReference[oaicite:6]{index=6}

Use the dedicated Block C page for exact plot, house and resale checks.

## Plot sizes in Faisal Town Phase 1

Across the Phase 1 project, common residential categories include:

- 5 marla
- 8 marla
- 10 marla
- 14 marla
- 1 kanal

However, not every size is available in every block.

For example:

- Blocks A and B are commonly associated with 8, 10, 14 marla and 1 kanal
- Block C includes smaller 5-marla inventory as well
- Block B-1 is commonly marketed with 5, 8 and 10 marla categories

Always verify the actual dimensions from the property documents.

## Faisal Town Phase 1 plots for sale

Phase 1 has an active resale market.

Current property portals show hundreds of Faisal Town F-18 residential plot listings, with substantial inventory inside Phase 1. :contentReference[oaicite:7]{index=7}

Listings may include:

- numbered plots
- open files
- fully paid plots
- plots with outstanding dues
- possession properties
- corner plots
- main-road plots
- commercial inventory

Before comparing price, establish what is actually being sold.

## Phase 1 prices

There is no single Faisal Town Phase 1 plot price.

Current asking prices vary by:

- block
- plot size
- exact street
- road width
- corner position
- main-road location
- possession
- dues
- plot level
- surrounding occupancy
- seller urgency

For example, current 8-marla listings across Phase 1 can differ substantially even within the same block. :contentReference[oaicite:8]{index=8}

For SEO and buyer usefulness, this hub should avoid one generic Phase 1 price table.

Keep current price examples on the individual Block A, B and C pages instead.

## Houses for sale in Faisal Town Phase 1

Phase 1 also has an established built-home market.

A house purchase should be evaluated differently from a plot.

In addition to ownership and location, inspect:

- construction age
- structure
- seepage
- plumbing
- electrical systems
- roof condition
- parking
- finishing
- layout
- repair cost
- occupancy status

A ready house can reduce the need to wait for construction but may carry significant renovation costs.

## Rentals in Phase 1

Phase 1 also has rental activity because it is more established than newer sector-based projects.

For rental or investment property, check:

- realistic monthly rent
- tenant demand
- vacancy
- property condition
- maintenance cost
- location
- nearby services
- parking
- lease terms

Do not treat advertised rent as guaranteed income.

## How to compare Block A, B, B-1 and C

Do not choose from block name alone.

Compare the same or similar plot size across blocks using:

- asking price
- exact location
- access
- road width
- development
- possession
- dues
- surrounding occupancy
- total transaction cost

For example, a stronger street in Block B may be more useful to one buyer than a cheaper property in another block.

A buyer needing a smaller 5-marla category may look more closely at Block C or B-1.

## Phase 1 for end users

Phase 1 may appeal to end users who prefer an established environment where the exact street and surrounding houses can be inspected before purchase.

For family use, consider:

- route to the property
- street width
- surrounding occupancy
- nearby commercial activity
- utilities
- noise
- plot orientation
- practical daily access

The cheapest plot is not necessarily the best home location.

## Phase 1 for investors

Investors may focus more on:

- entry price
- block demand
- plot size
- road position
- resale liquidity
- competing inventory
- current development
- total acquisition cost

The established nature of Phase 1 gives buyers more live resale data than a very new project, but this does not guarantee future appreciation.

## Phase 1 vs Faisal Town Phase 2

Faisal Town Phase 1 and Phase 2 should be kept clearly separate.

### Phase 1

Phase 1 uses block references such as:

- Block A
- Block B
- Block B-1
- Block C

### Phase 2

Phase 2 uses sector and enclave references such as:

- Sector O
- Sector P
- Sector R
- Sector S
- Sector T
- Overseas Enclave

The projects have different maps, payment structures, development stages and buyer expectations.

If your priority is established resale inventory or a ready house, Phase 1 may be the more relevant starting point.

If your priority is a newer sector-based project or longer-term development opportunity, compare the Phase 2 hub.

## Phase 1 buyer checklist

Before making an offer:

1. Confirm the property is in Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18.
2. Confirm the exact block.
3. Match the plot or house number with the Phase 1 map.
4. Verify dimensions.
5. Check ownership documentation.
6. Confirm transfer status.
7. Check possession.
8. Verify outstanding dues.
9. Inspect the site.
10. Compare similar properties.
11. Calculate transfer costs and taxes.
12. Obtain written payment instructions.

For Block B-1 or any newer inventory, also verify the current project and regulatory position before payment.
